nom: DHC Deep Cleansing Oil Facial Cleanser

avis.texte: I didn't find this product to do anything to my face after testing it out for a while. I was reaching for other cleansers over this brand.

avis.titre: Started the downfall of my skin
avis.texte: I had heard wonderful things about this cleansing oil for years and finally decided to give it a try with my birthday coupon in March. I used it maybe 3 times, maybe I went a little too far by using it for a few minutes too long at first; my skin was relatively smooth before this (barring some pesky hormonal acne I've always dealt with), but this oil cleanser RUINED it. I broke out in places I'd never broken out before (right on my lip line, hairline, etc). Deeeeep and painful cystic pimples. It also dried my skin out horribly and now, 5 months later, I am still paying the price and my skin is worse than it was when I was a 13 year old acne ridden middle schooler. Avoid at all costs. (Prior to this, I had mildly sensitive combination/normal skin with hormonal acne. Now my face is drier than a desert and reactive to anything stronger than then very basics).

I've used this twice and willing to give it one last try to see if I should keep it. But the first 2 tries was not impressive and I hate the feeling of getting blurry vision after I wash my face, that scares me a bit. It also doesn't remove mascara, even just the non-waterproof ones so that part is a big negative for me especially if it's this pricey. (At least I think it's pricey) It does remove make-up well just not the mascara. Also, the consistency is a bit thinned out and have to use a lot of product for one use.

I honestly read the reviews and did not think that it could happen to me. I received horrible chemical burns underneath my eyebrows and on the side of my mouth from this product. It has been a week and I have not seen improvement. I use this product twice and the damage that it caused my skin is significant. I do not recommend this product to anyone not even a stranger.

avis.titre: Great product if oil is fresh.
avis.texte: If the oil is fresh it is great, washed off my face with only water without leaving residue. If the oil isn't fresh it has an old rancid smell to it and should not be used. I've been using for 4 years without any breakouts or issues. Smell before you buy. Also should be lighter in color.

avis.titre: I would never buy this again
avis.texte: This oil gave me 5 styes and horrible cystic acne, all in less than a month. I have never had a break out like this in my life. I followed the instructions and within hours of using it the first time, I had a stye and a face full of pimples.

This is one that I didn't realize how good it was until I switched back to another cleanser. This really removes makeup and your face feels so clean and fresh and moisturized after. The smell is minimal but pleasant. Simple list of ingredients (I have never compared to washing my face with straight olive oil but I hesitate to do that). It goes on sale pretty regularly so add to your wishlist and watch for sales! This is another one that if I had to pay full price for I would.

I searched for a good cleanser for several months. I finally came across this one. It fully removes all makeup and it does so quickly. Also, The oil will come off with just simply washing your face, no residue left behind. I will continue to purchase.

This feels, smells, and looks like olive oil. it did not fully remove my KVD mascara but did remove mac foundation. I tried it 5 times. I followed with a cleanser on my whole face including eye lids, it resulted in a sty in my eye twice. I think there is too much oil in this. I was looking for alternative because Mac stopped making cleanse off oil, but this fell short of that product.

the little bottle that could got the small one and wow! great price AND great product. i realized i was using to harsh cleansers for my skin and wanted to try an oil one, and wow it keeps my skin from drying out and my go to for getting makeup off

Bought this on the Ulta 21-day Sale and have no doubt I will replace it, even at full price, when it runs out. It is truly the only cleanser I've used that cleans all the makeup off my face while leaving my skin hydrated. I have extremely sensitive skin, especially on my face, and my skin didn't skip a beat testing this. I also secretly love that I can apply the cleanser to DRY skin and it lathers to remove all the makeup! Mind blown. My sink looks less like a bird bath post makeup removing ritual.
I always use double cleansing method and this one is my favorite.
I don't understand how this has so many good reviews because it is such a watery formula. You have to pump it 5 times in order for it to even be enough for your whole face. It also broke me out too.

I got this on a trip to Japan agtet the hotel we wete staying at provided it. So glad Ulta carries it now! It is by far the kost gentle, but full force cleansing oil i have found. Use it on dry skin for makeup removal and it gets it all. I have combo skin and very very acne prone. This doesnt brrak me out at all. I follow using this with my normal cleanser and my skin is so happy!

This used to be my holy grail. Went through bottles years ago. I have clear skin i just use it for sebaceous filaments on my nose. Decided to test it out on my whole face. Huge mistake. Like the other (admittedly few) 1 star reviews - my jaw and chin are covered in break outs. At least 12 on each side. Plz no. Im never using it on my entire face again. Ugh
I was looking for an oil cleanser that was more economical that melted makeup like another much more expensive product I use. The DHC was good, however unfortunately not as good as the pricey one.
I tried so mant oil cleansers to try to find a more affordable one, but this one is honestly worth the price because its the best one and the bottle does last a good amount of time :)

avis.titre: After 15 years, I keep going back to this
avis.texte: This was my first oil cleanser, before there were as many, and double cleansing wasnt a big thing. This really gets my skin clean, but does not strip my skin. This was great when I had oily, acne prone skin. Now my skin is very dry, and it works great. The price is fair, because a bottle lasts a long time. Sometimes ill let it sit on my skin a lottle longer to help my clogged pores.

After leaving a prior negative review I thought I would try this product one more time. I woke up to irritated, red, dry skin even after doubling up on moisturizer before bed. Then I compared my cotton pad after making sure I didn't forget my Deep Cleansing Oil. There was no dirt or make up left behind. I've been a loyal user ever since.
